GPU_MEM_SIZE = 80 # GB


def _kvpr(mlist):
    """KVPR of a single GPU's model list."""
    free = GPU_MEM_SIZE - sum(m.model_size for m in mlist)
    if not mlist or free <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return sum(m.req_rate / m.slo for m in mlist) / free


def _place_under_threshold(gpu_num, models, T):
    """Feasibility test: try to place all models so every GPU's KVPR <= T.
    Sort models by pressure (desc); each model goes to the feasible GPU
    (free memory and KVPR <= T after placement) whose resulting KVPR is
    smallest; tiebreak by most free memory. Returns placement or None."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num
    for m in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
        best = None
        for g in range(gpu_num):
            if m.model_size < free[g]:
                k = (load[g] + m.req_rate / m.slo) / (free[g] - m.model_size)
                if k <= T and (best is None or k < best[0]):
                    best = (k, g)
        if best is None:
            return None
        g = best[1]
        placement[g].append(m)
        load[g] += m.req_rate / m.slo
        free[g] -= m.model_size
    return placement


def _polish(p):
    """A few rounds of pairwise swap local search lowering max KVPR."""
    for _ in range(30):
        k = {g: _kvpr(p[g]) for g in p}
        cur = max(k.values())
        best_move = None
        for src in p:
            for m in list(p[src]):
                for dst in p:
                    if dst == src:
                        continue
                    sf = GPU_MEM_SIZE - sum(x.model_size for x in p[src])
                    df = GPU_MEM_SIZE - sum(x.model_size for x in p[dst])
                    for n in list(p[dst]):
                        if (m.model_size - n.model_size < df and
                                n.model_size - m.model_size < sf):
                            p[src].remove(m); p[dst].remove(n)
                            p[src].append(n); p[dst].append(m)
                            nm = max(_kvpr(p[g]) for g in p)
                            if nm < cur - 1e-12 and (best_move is None or nm < best_move[0]):
                                best_move = (nm, src, m, dst, n)
                            p[dst].remove(m); p[src].remove(n)
                            p[src].append(m); p[dst].append(n)
        if best_move is None:
            break
        _, src, m, dst, n = best_move
        p[src].remove(m); p[dst].remove(n)
        p[src].append(n); p[dst].append(m)
    return p


def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Binary search on the max-KVPR threshold: for each candidate T a
    greedy feasibility check places models so every GPU stays under T.
    The smallest feasible T (found via bisection) gives a balanced
    minimax placement, optionally polished by pairwise swaps."""
    # lower/upper bounds on achievable max KVPR
    total_press = sum(m.req_rate / m.slo for m in models)
    lo, hi = 0.0, total_press / (GPU_MEM_SIZE * gpu_num) + 1.0
    # check memory feasibility at all (bin packing by best-fit decreasing)
    sizes = sorted((m.model_size for m in models), reverse=True)
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    for s in sizes:
        cands = [g for g in range(gpu_num) if s < free[g]]
        if not cands:
            raise ValueError("Unable to place all models within GPU memory")
        g = min(cands, key=lambda g: free[g])
        free[g] -= s
    best = None
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2.0
        p = _place_under_threshold(gpu_num, models, mid)
        if p is not None:
            best, hi = p, mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    if best is None:
        # fallback: plain greedy, no threshold
        placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
        fr = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
        ld = [0.0] * gpu_num
        for m in sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
            b = None
            for g in range(gpu_num):
                if m.model_size < fr[g]:
                    k = (ld[g] + m.req_rate / m.slo) / (fr[g] - m.model_size)
                    if b is None or k < b[0]:
                        b = (k, g)
            if b is None:
                raise ValueError("Unable to place all models within GPU memory")
            g = b[1]
            placement[g].append(m)
            ld[g] += m.req_rate / m.slo
            fr[g] -= m.model_size
        best = placement
    best = _polish(best)
    return best

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test the algorithm

    from evaluator import generate_test_gpu_models
    from evaluator import calculate_kvcache_pressure
    from evaluator import safe_float
    import numpy as np

    test_cases = generate_test_gpu_models()
    all_kvpr = []
    for i, (gpu_num, gpu_models) in enumerate(test_cases):

        results = compute_model_placement(gpu_num, gpu_models)
        max_kvpr = calculate_kvcache_pressure(results)
        all_kvpr.append(safe_float(max_kvpr))

    avg_kvpr = np.mean(all_kvpr)
    if avg_kvpr != 0:
        avg_kvpr = 1.0 / avg_kvpr


    print(f"Max KVPR: {avg_kvpr:.3f}")
